## Checklist

- [ ] I used only synthetic data.
- [ ] Core behavior works offline or has an accessible degradation path.
- [ ] New text is plain, localizable, and adult-respectful.
- [ ] New controls have semantic labels, focus behavior, and large-text support.
- [ ] Documentation and tests reflect the change.
- [ ] I signed commits with the Developer Certificate of Origin.
